issues.on_page: Reclassifications column: Instruction (4,649,139); Categorical corporation and private (395,000)
issues.issue: The instruction part of the General Fund contra is set to the 1115 Career Academy amount, but p6 prints how the 32,149,602 eliminated from function lines splits by function: Instruction 4,649,139, Support services - Instruction 1,473,679, General administration 7,763,016, Central services 6,939,464, Operation and maintenance 9,225,010, Student transportation 1,704,294, Categorical corporation and private 395,000 (total 32,149,602). Under the extractor's own mapping (3400 categorical = instruction) the instruction contra should be -5,044,139 (-4,649,139 - 395,000), not -2,183,586. Matching 1115 to the Cooperative transfer is an inference the page doesn't print.

The 'support services' contra -29,966,016 also includes the 1,704,294 eliminated from Student transportation and 2,860,553 that p6 places in instruction/categorical. Per p6 it should be support services -25,401,169, plus a separate student transportation contra -1,704,294 (department Student Transportation), plus instruction -5,044,139. As it stands, detail student transportation is 18,964,093, while p6 Total Governmental Funds shows 17,259,799 (the difference is exactly 1,704,294). Grand totals are unaffected (contra still sums to -32,149,602).

Treating the internal payment to ESU 18 as a transfer is defensible, since p6 eliminates it. Putting the paying side in the General Fund schedule is an assumption: the p5 'General Fund' column combines the General, Depreciation and Contingency funds (beginning 137,672,627 + 42,728,908 + 10,416,973 = 190,818,508). p6 only shows that the eliminated function-line total 32,149,602 equals 25,501,109 + 6,648,493, not which fund paid. Arithmetic checks: 7,480,305 - 6,648,493 = 831,812; 26,227,871 - 726,762 + 6,648,493 = 32,149,602.

p19 doesn't print this split. It is derived from p6: Other Governmental Funds 'Transfers - other funds' 7,203,466 = 4,293,118 + 2,183,586 + 726,762, and 'Reimbursements and other' 254,443 = 234,843 + 19,600. The arithmetic holds and it matches the ESU 18 Co-op contracts elimination. Also, p6 groups the 234,843 under 'Reimbursements and other', while the detail calls it other charges for services.

The report's own detail shows this line is mostly not reimbursements: it includes Special Building 4,079,407 (donations 3,349,590, lease income 656,209, other 73,608), ESU other 466,465, Cooperative 254,443 and only 13,612 of refunds in the GF part. Donations are the dominant part; the review flag is already present.
Includes 1911 Local License Fees 169,395 (p7): 1,896,413 + 3,955,498 + 169,395 = 6,021,306. Fines are dominant, so the category is defensible; already flagged for review.

This is the Bond Fund 'Other' line (p5), which the Statement of Activities (p2) includes in Debt service 42,100,213 = 42,085,527 + 14,686. Principal vs interest is not stated, and disbursements[14] Debt service also combines principal and interest.
